audience: Engineers and students reading this as a practical guide to the Transformer
goal: A clean, blue, documentation-style user guide for the Transformer — easy to read, well-structured, with clear navigation
narrative_angle: A guided walkthrough: what the Transformer is, how each component works, and what results it achieves.
hero_message: The Transformer, explained: a practical guide to attention-based sequence modeling.
notes: Blue documentation / user-guide aesthetic (think a clean docs site like a product user guide). Primary color is blue (#2563eb-ish) on a light, near-white background; calm, highly READABLE, generous line-height and whitespace. Use a clear sticky top nav AND, if it helps, a left-hand section index for a docs feel. Present the method as numbered, well-spaced step sections with comfortable reading width. Rebuild result tables as clean native HTML tables with the best row bolded. Frame every figure in a consistent rounded bordered card. The attention-visualization figures must read upright (they have been rotation-corrected). Keep it friendly and professional, not flashy.
source_brief: Turn Attention Is All You Need into a blue, documentation-style user guide that a reader can follow step by step. Clean light theme with a blue accent, sticky navigation (optionally a left section index), numbered method steps, readable typography, native result tables with the winning row bolded, and every figure in a consistent framed card. Make sure the attention visualization figures are upright and readable.
